name: Michael's Zombies
desc:
Michael was displeased with you and placed you inside his Zombies pocket dimension. Will you be able to survive his wrath? Fight against endless waves of zombies alone or with friends!

Private servers allow you to play all previously available event maps and give admin commands!

Version 2.1.1:
HALLOWEEN IS BACK!
Hallows Eve 2024 returns! Certain maps have also been updated with some Halloween themed decor!

Controls: 
Interact - [F] / [Btn X]
Shoot - [Left Click] / [RT]
Reload - [R] / [Btn  X]
Aim  - [Q] / [Right Click] / [LB]
Switch - [1], [2], [3], [Scroll] / [Btn Y]
Sprint - [LShift] / [Left Joystick Btn]
Crouch / Slide - [C] / [LControl] / [Btn B]
Knife - [V] / [Right Joystick Btn]
Settings - [P] / [DPad Left]
Leaderboard [Tab] / [DPad Right]

scripts.title: DarkXZombies
scripts.features:
DarkXZombies | Michael's Zombies Cheat

Silent aim with wallbang — shoot through any wall directly at zombie heads. Every bullet hits the target, no matter what's in the way.

ESP shows all zombies on your screen — boxes, health bars, names with distance, and tracers pointing from the bottom of your screen to every zombie nearby.

Rapid fire 

Anti-kick keeps you connected 

RightShift toggles the menu. 

ESP colors: Red, Green, Blue, White, Yellow — pick what looks best on your screen.

Target part: Head for max damage, HumanoidRootPart for consistent hits, UpperTorso for easy aim.

FOV circle shows your aim radius on screen. Adjustable size from 50 to 1000.

Everything is server-validated friendly — silent aim hooks the actual fire function, wallbang hooks the raycast, rapid fire modifies gun settings before the server sees them.

scripts.title: melee kill aura
scripts.script:
local cd = 0
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    local character = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
    cd += delta
    if cd > 0.1 then
        cd = 0
        for _,v in workspace.Ignore.Zombies:GetChildren() do
            if v.ClassName == "Model" and v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (character.PrimaryPart.CFrame.Position - v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 25 and v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Framework.Remotes.KnifeHitbox:FireServer(v)
            end
        end
    end
end)

        return (LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - zombie.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= (dist or 30)
